notes: Monthly close ranking from the same admissible score vector for both arms, with permanent ID tie breaks.
Holdings retain their quantities except exits, corporate actions and a cap trim planned after a close above the cap.
A close-planned whole-share order executes at the next raw open. An opening gap violating settled cash or the position cap rejects the order.
Missing settlement cash can delay vacancies. Retry quantities are planned at a later close against the existing monthly targets.
Two-ATR entry stops, 0.5-percent equity risk per entry, prior-volume participation and a two-percent close-observed latch use the NYSE diagnostic risk settings from PR 290.
Monthly selection supplies the holding rule for this new experiment. The prior SMA diagnostic's twelve-session time exit is strategy-specific.
Daily-bar opening and adverse stop prices are execution assumptions. Quote size, halt coverage and broker fills remain unverified.
Each chronological block begins with fresh diagnostic capital. End-of-block holdings and receivables remain marked, without an invented terminal liquidation.
Positive or negative returns in synthetic fixtures verify software only. Market inputs remain development diagnostics.
